reuse.why: Puts the new rule in the existing getScheduledAmount and calls it from three sites, but those sites keep their own missing/number dispatch even though getScheduledAmount already handles null and numbers, and two midpoint copies are not routed through it.

duplication.why: Adds no new copy, but leaves the three-way null/number/range ternary repeated at three sites and the midpoint formula alive in forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the tree's home for schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the helper, its call sites' comments/expressions and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: The 'expected amount' rule now has two live definitions (furthest-from-zero in the helper, midpoint in forecasting and budget templates), so planning surfaces disagree and the next change must hunt copies again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts:100 and server/budget/schedule-template.ts:64 still compute the midpoint inline; app.ts updateActions/postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own null/number dispatch around getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: The rule changes in getScheduledAmount, but forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts still apply the midpoint rule in their own code.
